rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for how wide something is or its side-to-side measurement.

example.english: The width of this desk is just right; it can fit two computers.
example.traditional: 呢張枱嘅闊度啱啱好，放得落兩部電腦。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 ci4 ge3 fut3 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 fong3 dak1 lok6 loeng5 bou6 din6 nou5
